planning_notes: Board is fixed to arduino:avr:uno and wiring is preserved: button input on D2; TM1637 CLK on D4 and DIO on D5.

Button modeling assumes an internal pull-up with active_high=true meaning the model is true when the button is pressed (LOW input). If the physical circuit uses a different polarity (e.g., active-low without pull-up), SysML must handle the mismatch; do not invert again in the request.
Counter increment timing, debouncing, and 'one press = +1' edge detection are handled in the SysML model; the device requests only define the IO ports.
No serial reporting is required by the original requirements, so serial_channels is empty.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: Button press event (increment counter and update TM1637 display)

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: Counter value displayed on TM1637 (increment by 1 per button press)
